listing.title: Electric Razor for Men, Full Metal Foil Shaver with 4 Floating Blades, IPX7 Waterproof Wet/Dry, 120-Min Runtime USB-C Rechargeable Travel Groomer with LED Display & Lock

bullets.text: [CLOSE SHAVE WITHOUT THE PULLING] Engineered with 4 floating blades (3 ultra-thin foils and 1 specialized trimmer), this electric razor captures flat-lying stubble in a single pass. It smoothly adapts to your facial contours to deliver a clean, close shave—saving your morning time and saving your skin from painful pulling or razor burn.

[HEAVY-DUTY METAL BUILD& WHISPER QUIET] Upgrade from flimsy, rattling plastic shavers. The EchoByte features a solid, weighted metal casing that not only feels incredibly durable in your hand but naturally absorbs motor vibrations. You get a remarkably stable grip and a quiet shave that won’t wake up the rest of the house.

[120-MIN RUNTIME & SMART LED] One less device you have to worry about charging every day. A single USB-C charge delivers up to 2 hours of continuous cordless power. The clear LED screen shows your exact battery percentage, and if you’re ever caught off guard, a quick 5-minute plug-in is all you need for a full shave.

[IPX7 WATERPROOF & ZERO-FUSS CLEANING] 100% waterproof for a quick dry shave on the go or a comfortable wet shave in the shower. We know you hate tedious cleaning, so we made it easy: the magnetic shaver head pops off instantly, letting you flush trapped hair directly under the faucet in seconds.

[POCKET-SIZED WITH SECURE TRAVEL LOCK] Smaller than your smartphone, this mini groomer fits perfectly into any gym bag or carry-on luggage. Just hold the power button to engage the smart Travel Lock, ensuring it never turns on accidentally and drains the battery in transit. A rugged, reliable tool built for men on the move.
